habitat: Broken-English internal-monologue captions in multicolored Comic Sans; more recently, cryptocurrency branding.
diet: Feeds on a deadpan animal expression paired with deliberately fractured syntax.
predators: None documented, though the photographer has licensed the image commercially, which implies an enforcement posture the museum has not stress-tested.
transmission: Static photograph with overlaid caption text; largely unchanged in visual format since 2013.
cause_of_death: Not applicable. The most durable specimen in the collection by cultural reach — it now anchors an entire cryptocurrency.
resurrection: Continuous, driven less by nostalgia than by an active market: Dogecoin.
host_population: General internet culture, plus, distinctly, cryptocurrency communities.
mutation: Extensive: the caption style spread to other animals ('doge-speak') independent of the original photograph.
prognosis: Ask before displaying at full resolution. The photographer is reachable and has licensed before — the most commercially active image in the collection outside the litigated cases.
enforcement_history: No litigation found. Owner has licensed commercially and participated in charitable and crypto-adjacent ventures.
curatorial_note: Photograph, not a public-domain image. Japanese author, so Berne applies but enforcement posture is unclear. Ask before displaying at full resolution.
